method: Read-only local pack, source and historical parquet inspection. Isolated group_of function evaluated from AST without importing the side-effecting pipeline module. No network, browser, game/data changes or pipeline generation.

conclusion.summary: Both exact shipped boards are already classified food and pass the downstream kitchen rules. For Bhagyanagar Institute of Police, an exact-ID September Overture record carries public_safety_service; the current bare-pub rule demonstrably classifies that historical input as food. Missing October/raw merged inputs prevent conclusive attribution of the shipped classification. Kushaiguda original classification remains untraced.

sourceChain.finding: Configured import release is 2026-10-21.0 and reads basic_category, taxonomy.primary and hierarchy.
group_of checks category text first. The food rule appears first and contains unbounded pub; Overture text includes basic category, primary category and hierarchy.
Merged group is selected from grouped source records; UID uses first 16 characters of an Overture source ID when present. businesses.json preserves category and complete source_ids.
Placement copies group and provider names but drops complete source_ids/category from this record.

Shipped board retains group, confidence, slot and name; ground-floor food boards with confidence≥0.5 become kitchen candidates unless named bus stop/station, paan shop, beeda, ATM or parking. Police/institute names are not excluded.
Core aggregates exported city_pois food records.
Runtime food eligibility removes short/locality-only labels; makeOffer prefers pizza only some of the time and otherwise uses the food pool.

exactMatches.interpretation: Exact historical source UUID and name reconstruct the shipped board ID. The current classifier demonstrably matches pub inside public_safety_service and returns food. This establishes a concrete mechanism for this older source record; the shipped 2026-10-21 input has not been recovered.
